Class FoodPerInventorPairEffect

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.effects.buildings.FoodPerInventorPairEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
BuildingEffect
public class FoodPerInventorPairEffect extends Object implements BuildingEffect
Building effect that grants 3 food every time the player completes a new inventor pair after acquiring this building. The effect tracks the last known pair count to award food only on net new completions.
